essence: It defines pain as separation and pleasure as union (v.1), then proves the definition across twenty moves: the impure instant wiped (2), abiding unto death (3), pride sanctified (4), perception-as-it-stands as fitness (5), meditation-vision-touch sequence (6), the mutually grounding pair of seeing and festival (7), drinking through every sense (8), the country with no other (9), slavery as fitness (10), grace that never deliberates turned back on its delay (11), beholding with one's own hands inside and out (12), ascent by mere wish (13), worship answering touch (14), joy swelling the world (15), fearlessness as perception's corollary (16), poison turned nectar by stance (17), songs wanted otherwise (18), the uncountable play that withholds the cup (19), entering-and-praising the fathomless (20).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of rehearsal (abhyāsa); the vyabhicāri is clarity (prasāda) of the whole path compressed into recitable moves. The rasa is the tranquility of daily rehearsal — definition, purification, pride, perception, worship, grace-logic, ascent, cosmology, refuge in one sitting. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as śānta: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute summarized. Lakshmanjoo's commentary on v.13 compares grace to Scotch Whisky — the rasa is intoxication-without-intoxication, the bliss of abiding in the Lord's abode.
